title: Oral History of Steve Naroff Part 1, Session 1
summary: Computer History Museum oral history of Steve Naroff, an engineer at Stepstone, NeXT and Apple who worked on Objective-C. This first session covers his childhood, music background and early career.
why: Pointed to as a primary-source account of Objective-C's origins and the early days of NeXT and Apple.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The Computer History Museum has a two part interview with Steve Naroff, one of the engineers who worked on Objective C
